thoughts.text: If you want to be rich, learn a trade. Wealth diminishes with time, but a skill does not.
thoughts.author: Abai Kunanbaev
thoughts.source: The Book of Words, Word Thirty-Three
thoughts.original: Мал жұтайды, өнер жұтамайды.

thoughts.text: The sooner you admit the mistake to yourself, the cheaper it costs you.
thoughts.author: Akmal Paiziev
thoughts.source: Spot.uz interview, “Цена провала: Акмаль Пайзиев про свои ошибки, проблемы со спецслужбами, закрытые проекты и сделанные выводы” (11 July 2019)
thoughts.original: Чем раньше ты эту ошибку себе признаешь, тем дешевле она тебе обойдется.

thoughts.text: In speech there is nothing so contemptible as a lie.
thoughts.author: Alisher Navoi
thoughts.source: Hayrat ul-Abror (Wonder of the Good), c. 1483
thoughts.original: So‘z aro yolg‘on kibi yo‘q nopisand

thoughts.text: If you say ‘I know,’ then you are far from knowledge, and among the wise you will be counted as foolish.
thoughts.author: Yusuf Balasaguni
thoughts.source: Kutadgu Bilig (Wisdom of Royal Glory), trans. Robert Dankoff

thoughts.text: When mistakes are hidden, they breed new mistakes, or the problem gets worse. I allow mistakes, only not repeated ones.
thoughts.author: Zafar Khashimov
thoughts.source: Spot.uz interview, “Цена провала: Зафар Хашимов о том, как шесть лет закрывал City Taxi, почему не взлетел Five, своих ошибках и страхах” (11 August 2021)
thoughts.original: Когда ошибки скрывают, это вызывает новые ошибки или усугубление проблемы. Я позволяю ошибаться, но только без повторов.

thoughts.text: I read the Metaphysics forty times, until I had the text by heart, and still I did not understand it. Then a broker sold me a commentary for four dirhams, and at once the whole thing was clear.
thoughts.author: Ibn Sina (Avicenna)
thoughts.source: Autobiography, in Avicenna on Theology, trans. A. J. Arberry

thoughts.text: I think failure is massively overrated.
thoughts.author: Peter Thiel
thoughts.source: The Tim Ferriss Show, episode 28

thoughts.text: I believe we are the best place in the world to fail (we have plenty of practice!), and failure and invention are inseparable twins. To invent you have to experiment, and if you know in advance that it’s going to work, it’s not an experiment.
thoughts.author: Jeff Bezos
thoughts.source: 2015 Letter to Shareholders

thoughts.text: Startups rarely die in mid keystroke. So keep typing!
thoughts.author: Paul Graham
thoughts.source: How Not to Die

thoughts.text: The best ideas are fragile; most people don’t even start talking about them at all because they sound silly.
thoughts.author: Sam Altman
thoughts.source: Idea Generation

thoughts.text: I didn’t see it then, but it turned out that getting fired from Apple was the best thing that could have ever happened to me.
thoughts.author: Steve Jobs
thoughts.source: Stanford Commencement Address, 2005

thoughts.text: If there is quarrelling at the plowing, there will be no fighting at the threshing. Settle the matter at the start of the dealing, so no dispute appears at the end.
thoughts.author: Mahmud al-Kashgari
thoughts.source: Dīwān Lughāt al-Turk, 1072–74 — Turkic proverb recorded by al-Kashgari, with his own Arabic gloss
thoughts.original: Sabanda sandrış bolsa, örtgünde irtiş bolmas

thoughts.text: I had nothing to risk, because I started from the floor.
thoughts.author: Mikheil Lomtadze
thoughts.source: Collected interview quotes, Digital Business
thoughts.original: Мне нечем было рисковать, потому что я начинал с плинтуса.

thoughts.text: No one will deny that in questions of historic authenticity hearsay does not equal eye-witness.
thoughts.author: Al-Biruni
thoughts.source: Alberuni’s India, c. 1030, Preface, trans. Edward C. Sachau

thoughts.text: If you’re from Yakutsk and you’re building something global without access to big resources, you have to think unconventionally.
thoughts.author: Arsen Tomsky
thoughts.source: Talk at the UMAI forum, Astana, reported by Digital Business
thoughts.original: Если ты родом из Якутска и делаешь какую-то глобальную историю, не имея доступа к большим ресурсам, то тебе нужно мыслить нестандартно.

thoughts.text: For a first business the only thing that matters is starting. It doesn’t matter what you do. What matters is aiming, from the first day, to build it better than anyone in the world.
thoughts.author: Ramil Mukhoryapov
thoughts.source: Interview, «Chocofamily станет больше Google, Facebook и Amazon», Zhazhda
thoughts.original: Для первого бизнеса главное – начать. Не имеет значения, чем заниматься. Главное – сразу же стремиться строить этот бизнес лучше всех в мире.

thoughts.text: Winners quit fast, quit often, and quit without guilt.
thoughts.author: Seth Godin
thoughts.source: The Dip

thoughts.text: No business plan survives first contact with customers.
thoughts.author: Steve Blank
thoughts.source: No Business Plan Survives First Contact With Customers

thoughts.text: Skill is established in you only by repeating its actions many times. Repeat bad writing and bad writing is what takes hold; repeat excellent writing and you get that instead.
thoughts.author: Al-Farabi
thoughts.source: Selected Aphorisms (Fusul al-Madani), aphorism 9

thoughts.text: When I considered what people generally want in calculating, I found that it always is a number.
thoughts.author: Al-Khwarizmi
thoughts.source: The Algebra of Mohammed ben Musa, c. 820, trans. Frederic Rosen, 1831

thoughts.text: Business success contains the seeds of its own destruction. The more successful you are, the more people want a chunk of your business and then another chunk and then another until there is nothing left.
thoughts.author: Andy Grove
thoughts.source: Only the Paranoid Survive

thoughts.text: The Struggle is when people ask you why you don’t quit and you don’t know the answer.
thoughts.author: Ben Horowitz
thoughts.source: The Struggle

thoughts.text: Markets that don’t exist don’t care how smart you are.
thoughts.author: Marc Andreessen
thoughts.source: The Pmarca Guide to Startups, part 4: The only thing that matters

thoughts.text: If you’re not embarrassed by the first version of your product, you’ve launched too late.
thoughts.author: Reid Hoffman
thoughts.source: Reid Hoffman on X

thoughts.text: Losing money isn’t the frightening part. Losing trust is.
thoughts.author: Timur Turlov
thoughts.source: «Я — покупатель денег»: 10 цитат Тимура Турлова про бизнес, успех и черный день, Digital Business
thoughts.original: Не страшно потерять деньги — страшно потерять доверие.

thoughts.text: The stronger the culture, the less corporate process a company needs.
thoughts.author: Brian Chesky
thoughts.source: Don’t Fuck Up the Culture

thoughts.text: We are honest with our clients: before they make a transaction they can already see what each service costs in the app. We have no so-called hidden fees.
thoughts.author: David Melikidze
thoughts.source: Большое интервью с генеральным директором Payme, Spot.uz
thoughts.original: Мы честны перед клиентами — еще перед совершением транзакции они видят, сколько стоит та или иная услуга в приложении. У нас нет так называемых скрытых комиссий.

thoughts.text: Ideas are worth nothing unless executed. They are just a multiplier. Execution is worth millions.
thoughts.author: Derek Sivers
thoughts.source: Ideas are just a multiplier of execution

thoughts.text: Until you have users, you don’t have a product. Until they’re paying you, you don’t have a business.
thoughts.author: Des Traynor
thoughts.source: How Intercom got our first customers

thoughts.text: There’s a silly notion that failure’s not an option at NASA. Failure is an option here. If things are not failing, you are not innovating enough.
thoughts.author: Elon Musk
thoughts.source: Inc., “Entrepreneur of the Year, 2007: Elon Musk”

thoughts.text: A startup is a human institution designed to create a new product or service under conditions of extreme uncertainty.
thoughts.author: Eric Ries
thoughts.source: The Lean Startup

thoughts.text: Until you actually start making something, your brilliant idea is just that, an idea.
thoughts.author: Jason Fried and David Heinemeier Hansson
thoughts.source: Rework

thoughts.text: One of the things you can definitely guarantee is where there are no customers, there are also no competitors.
thoughts.author: Jensen Huang
thoughts.source: Caltech commencement address, 2024

thoughts.text: I’d say determination is the single most important quality in a startup founder. If the founders I spoke with were superhuman in any way, it was in their perseverance.
thoughts.author: Jessica Livingston
thoughts.source: Founders at Work

thoughts.text: Your job, as a manager, is to get better outcomes from a group of people working together.
thoughts.author: Julie Zhuo
thoughts.source: The Making of a Manager

thoughts.text: A business leader’s job is to create great teams that do amazing work on time. That’s it. That’s the job of management.
thoughts.author: Patty McCord
thoughts.source: Powerful: Building a Culture of Freedom and Responsibility

thoughts.text: My dad encouraged us to fail. Growing up, he would ask us what we failed at that week. If we didn’t have something, he would be disappointed.
thoughts.author: Sara Blakely
thoughts.source: Entrepreneur, “Sara Blakely on Resilience”

thoughts.text: Better to try and regret it.
thoughts.author: Akmal Payziev
thoughts.source: Interview, «Основатель MyTaxi и Express24 Акмаль Пайзиев о своем подходе», Kapital.uz
thoughts.original: Конечно, лучше попробовать и пожалеть.

thoughts.text: The battle between every startup and incumbent comes down to whether the startup gets distribution before the incumbent gets innovation.
thoughts.author: Alex Rampell
thoughts.source: Distribution vs. Innovation

thoughts.text: Retention is the single most important thing for growth.
thoughts.author: Alex Schultz
thoughts.source: How to Start a Startup, Lecture 6: Growth

thoughts.text: Over time, all marketing strategies result in shitty clickthrough rates.
thoughts.author: Andrew Chen
thoughts.source: The Law of Shitty Clickthroughs

thoughts.text: When a great team meets a lousy market, market wins. When a lousy team meets a great market, market wins. When a great team meets a great market, something special happens.
thoughts.author: Andy Rachleff
thoughts.source: quoted in Marc Andreessen, “The Only Thing That Matters”

thoughts.text: Make your customer the hero of your story.
thoughts.author: Ann Handley
thoughts.source: Make Your Customer the Hero of Your Story

thoughts.text: Positioning defines what market you intend to win and why you deserve to win it.
thoughts.author: April Dunford
thoughts.source: An Introduction to Positioning

thoughts.text: Fearlessness is not the absence of fear. Rather, it’s the mastery of fear.
thoughts.author: Arianna Huffington
thoughts.source: On Becoming Fearless

thoughts.text: Enthusiastic skepticism is not the enemy of boundless optimism. It’s optimism’s perfect partner.
thoughts.author: Astro Teller
thoughts.source: The unexpected benefit of celebrating failure (TED2016)

thoughts.text: Your title makes you a manager. Your people make you a leader.
thoughts.author: Bill Campbell
thoughts.source: Trillion Dollar Coach (Schmidt, Rosenberg & Eagle)

thoughts.text: Success is a lousy teacher. It seduces smart people into thinking they can’t lose.
thoughts.author: Bill Gates
thoughts.source: The Road Ahead

thoughts.text: The reality of growth is that there is never a silver bullet.
thoughts.author: Brian Balfour
thoughts.source: The First Step To Building A Growth Machine

thoughts.text: Say the thing you think you cannot say.
thoughts.author: Claire Hughes Johnson
thoughts.source: Scaling People

thoughts.text: When I write an advertisement, I don’t want you to tell me that you find it ‘creative.’ I want you to find it so interesting that you buy the product.
thoughts.author: David Ogilvy
thoughts.source: Ogilvy on Advertising

thoughts.text: The happiest and most successful people I know don’t just love what they do, they’re obsessed with solving an important problem, something that matters to them.
thoughts.author: Drew Houston
thoughts.source: MIT commencement address, 2013

thoughts.text: Leadership is about empowering other people as a result of your presence, and making sure that impact continues into your absence.
thoughts.author: Frances Frei
thoughts.source: Unleashed (with Anne Morriss)

thoughts.text: Almost every failed startup has a product. What failed startups don’t have are enough customers.
thoughts.author: Gabriel Weinberg
thoughts.source: Traction

thoughts.text: Today is brutal, tomorrow is more brutal, but the day after tomorrow is beautiful. However, the majority of people will die tomorrow night.
thoughts.author: Jack Ma
thoughts.source: quoted in Duncan Clark, Alibaba: The House That Jack Ma Built

thoughts.text: To deliver good service, built out from what a person actually needs: that is the founding principle of our work.
thoughts.author: Jasur Jumaev
thoughts.source: Interview with the heads of Click and Uzum, Kapital.uz
thoughts.original: Предоставить качественный сервис, исходя из потребностей человека — это основной принцип нашей работы.

thoughts.text: How have I been complicit in creating the conditions I say I don’t want?
thoughts.author: Jerry Colonna
thoughts.source: Reboot: Leadership and the Art of Growing Up

thoughts.text: Great vision without great people is irrelevant.
thoughts.author: Jim Collins
thoughts.source: Good to Great

thoughts.text: If you are succeeding, it means you’re constantly growing into situations you’ve never experienced before.
thoughts.author: Kathryn Minshew
thoughts.source: Famous Failures interview with Ozan Varol

thoughts.text: A true fan is defined as a fan that will buy anything you produce.
thoughts.author: Kevin Kelly
thoughts.source: 1,000 True Fans

thoughts.text: Radical Candor really just means saying what you think while also giving a damn about the person you’re saying it to.
thoughts.author: Kim Scott
thoughts.source: Radical Candor

thoughts.text: A good rule of thumb is to hire only people who are better than you. Do not compromise. Ever.
thoughts.author: Laszlo Bock
thoughts.source: Work Rules!

thoughts.text: People tell us we just got lucky, that the companies relocated to us. I remember the nights we didn’t sleep, defending the preferences, building the whole system. That is not luck.
thoughts.author: Magzhan Madiyev
thoughts.source: Interview, «Как цифровой майнинг помог Astana Hub», Forbes Kazakhstan
thoughts.original: Нам часто говорят: вам просто повезло, к вам релоцировались компании. А я вспоминаю, как мы ночами не спали, защищали преференции и всю систему строили. Это не просто «повезло».

thoughts.text: There are bad ideas. But you don’t know an idea is bad until you’ve tried it.
thoughts.author: Marc Randolph
thoughts.source: That Will Never Work

thoughts.text: We’ve got a two-step plan: to build one of the world’s most valuable companies and do the most good we can.
thoughts.author: Melanie Perkins
thoughts.source: SXSW Sydney, 2024

thoughts.text: I’ve failed over and over and over again in my life. And that is why I succeed.
thoughts.author: Michael Jordan
thoughts.source: Nike “Failure” commercial, 1997

thoughts.text: Wind extinguishes a candle and energizes fire. Likewise with randomness, uncertainty, chaos: you want to use them, not hide from them. You want to be the fire and wish for the wind.
thoughts.author: Nassim Nicholas Taleb
thoughts.source: Antifragile

thoughts.text: Play long-term games with long-term people. All returns in life, whether in wealth, relationships, or knowledge, come from compound interest.
thoughts.author: Naval Ravikant
thoughts.source: Naval Ravikant, on X

thoughts.text: If your product is Great, it doesn’t need to be Good.
thoughts.author: Paul Buchheit
thoughts.source: If your product is Great, it doesn’t need to be Good (blog post)

thoughts.text: Executives spend more time on managing people and making people decisions than on anything else, and they should. No other decisions are so long lasting in their consequences or so difficult to unmake.
thoughts.author: Peter Drucker
thoughts.source: How to Make People Decisions (Harvard Business Review, July 1985)

thoughts.text: The brick walls are there for a reason. The brick walls are not there to keep us out. The brick walls are there to give us a chance to show how badly we want something.
thoughts.author: Randy Pausch
thoughts.source: The Last Lecture: Really Achieving Your Childhood Dreams

thoughts.text: Pain + Reflection = Progress.
thoughts.author: Ray Dalio
thoughts.source: Principles

thoughts.text: Lead with context, not control.
thoughts.author: Reed Hastings
thoughts.source: No Rules Rules: Netflix and the Culture of Reinvention

thoughts.text: We’re raising our girls to be perfect, and we’re raising our boys to be brave.
thoughts.author: Reshma Saujani
thoughts.source: Teach girls bravery, not perfection (TED2016)

thoughts.text: A flower is simply a weed with an advertising budget.
thoughts.author: Rory Sutherland
thoughts.source: Alchemy

thoughts.text: Ever tried. Ever failed. No matter. Try again. Fail again. Fail better.
thoughts.author: Samuel Beckett
thoughts.source: Worstward Ho

thoughts.text: Growing users without growing users that complete the core action is the empty calories of growth. It feels good, but it’s not good for you.
thoughts.author: Sarah Tavel
thoughts.source: The Hierarchy of Engagement

thoughts.text: A growth hacker is a person whose true north is growth.
thoughts.author: Sean Ellis
thoughts.source: Find a Growth Hacker for Your Startup

thoughts.text: Results! Why, man, I have gotten a lot of results! I know several thousand things that won’t work.
thoughts.author: Thomas Edison
thoughts.source: Edison: His Life and Inventions (Dyer & Martin, 1910)

thoughts.text: If you find a book you really want to read but it hasn’t been written yet, then you must write it.
thoughts.author: Toni Morrison
thoughts.source: Address to the Ohio Arts Council, 1981

thoughts.text: The best ideas are painkillers, not vitamins.
thoughts.author: Tony Fadell
thoughts.source: Build: An Unorthodox Guide to Making Things Worth Making

thoughts.text: I like to say my willingness to fail is what gives me the ability to succeed.
thoughts.author: Vinod Khosla
thoughts.source: Stanford GSB, “Be Wary of ‘Stupid Advice’”

thoughts.text: Every successful entrepreneur was buying a bank, so we decided to as well. Truth is, we had no idea what the banking business even was.
thoughts.author: Vyacheslav Kim
thoughts.source: «Откуда взялся и как устроен Kaspi», Business FM Kazakhstan
thoughts.original: Все успешные предприниматели покупали банки, вот и мы решили. Правда, мы не понимали, что вообще представляет из себя банковский бизнес.

thoughts.text: I personally love being underestimated. I think it’s a total superpower.
thoughts.author: Whitney Wolfe Herd
thoughts.source: Aspen Ideas Festival, 2022

thoughts.text: He who sells the fruits of his labor without trying to deceive is considered saintly by the people.
thoughts.author: Abai Kunanbaev
thoughts.source: The Book of Words, Word Thirty-Three
thoughts.original: Алдау қоспай адал еңбегін сатқан қолөнерлі — қазақтың әулиесі сол.

thoughts.text: Success is an illusion: it makes a person weak and vulnerable. You have to understand that the probability of failure is higher than the probability of success.
thoughts.author: Akmal Paiziev
thoughts.source: Spot.uz interview, “Цена провала: Акмаль Пайзиев про свои ошибки, проблемы со спецслужбами, закрытые проекты и сделанные выводы” (11 July 2019)
thoughts.original: Я вообще считаю, что успех это иллюзия — он делает человека слабым и уязвимым. Надо понимать, что вероятность провала выше, чем вероятность успеха.

thoughts.text: A single word turns aside a calamity that scattered treasure could not.
thoughts.author: Alisher Navoi
thoughts.source: Hayrat ul-Abror (Wonder of the Good), c. 1483
thoughts.original: Bir so‘z etib oncha baliyatni daf’, / Kim, sochibon ganj yetishmay bu naf’.

thoughts.text: However much wisdom you possess, still seek to gain more; for the wise man attains his desire by inquiry.
thoughts.author: Yusuf Balasaguni
thoughts.source: Kutadgu Bilig (Wisdom of Royal Glory), trans. Robert Dankoff

thoughts.text: The story of success and the story of mistakes are inseparable. A success story is exactly that: the story of a chain of mistakes.
thoughts.author: Zafar Khashimov
thoughts.source: Spot.uz, Alter Ego interview: “Зафар Хашимов: об инвестициях, монополиях, НДС и ценах, будущем Узбекистана и многом другом” (15 April 2019)
thoughts.original: История успеха и история ошибок неразделимы. История успеха — это и есть история череды ошибок.

thoughts.text: With each proof I examined, I set down the premisses and put them in order in a file, then examined what deductions might be drawn from them.
thoughts.author: Ibn Sina (Avicenna)
thoughts.source: Autobiography, in Avicenna on Theology, trans. A. J. Arberry

thoughts.text: Brilliant thinking is rare, but courage is in even shorter supply than genius.
thoughts.author: Peter Thiel
thoughts.source: Zero to One

thoughts.text: I knew that if I failed I wouldn’t regret that, but I knew the one thing I might regret is not ever having tried.
thoughts.author: Jeff Bezos
thoughts.source: Academy of Achievement interview, 2001

thoughts.text: Live in the future, then build what’s missing.
thoughts.author: Paul Graham
thoughts.source: How to Get Startup Ideas

thoughts.text: A good test for an idea is if you can articulate why most people think it’s a bad idea, but you understand what makes it good.
thoughts.author: Sam Altman
thoughts.source: Idea Generation

thoughts.text: Everything around you that you call life was made up by people that were no smarter than you. And you can change it. You can influence it.
thoughts.author: Steve Jobs
thoughts.source: Santa Clara Valley Historical Association interview, 1994

thoughts.text: To the lazy man, even the shadow of a cloud is a burden.
thoughts.author: Mahmud al-Kashgari
thoughts.source: Dīwān Lughāt al-Turk, 1072–74 — Turkic proverb recorded by al-Kashgari
thoughts.original: Ermegüge bulit yük bolur

thoughts.text: The customer doesn’t care what technology you use. The customer sees, feels, hears, and touches it with their hands.
thoughts.author: Mikheil Lomtadze
thoughts.source: Collected interview quotes, Digital Business
thoughts.original: Клиенту все равно, какие вы технологии используете. Клиент видит, чувствует, слышит и трогает руками.

thoughts.text: Everything which exists on this subject in our literature is second-hand information which one has copied from the other, a farrago of materials never sifted by the sieve of critical examination.
thoughts.author: Al-Biruni
thoughts.source: Alberuni’s India, c. 1030, Preface, trans. Edward C. Sachau

thoughts.text: You have to find meanings. Build not for the money but for the meanings; they give you a great deal of inner strength, and they make you happy.
thoughts.author: Arsen Tomsky
thoughts.source: Talk at the UMAI forum, Astana, reported by Digital Business
thoughts.original: Надо найти смыслы. Создавать не ради денег, а ради смыслов, которые дают много внутренних сил и делают счастливым.

thoughts.text: Work. The activity an entrepreneur generates: meetings, negotiations, hiring the right team, raising capital, sales, marketing. That is the path to success in anything.
thoughts.author: Ramil Mukhoryapov
thoughts.source: Interview, «Chocofamily станет больше Google, Facebook и Amazon», Zhazhda
thoughts.original: Труд. Активность, которую создает предприниматель (встречи, переговоры, наем правильной команды, решение вопросов с госорганами, привлечение капитала, продажи, маркетинг) – это и есть путь к успеху в любом деле.

thoughts.text: If you don’t ship, you actually haven’t started anything at all.
thoughts.author: Seth Godin
thoughts.source: Poke the Box

thoughts.text: There are no facts inside your building, so get outside.
thoughts.author: Steve Blank
thoughts.source: The Customer Development Manifesto

thoughts.text: Practical intellect stays merely potential as long as experience has not been gathered. Only then does it become intellect in act, and it grows with each year of a life.
thoughts.author: Al-Farabi
thoughts.source: Selected Aphorisms (Fusul al-Madani), aphorism 38

thoughts.text: A short work on calculating by completion and reduction, confining it to what is easiest and most useful in arithmetic, such as men constantly require in cases of inheritance, legacies, partition, law-suits, and trade.
thoughts.author: Al-Khwarizmi
thoughts.source: The Algebra of Mohammed ben Musa, c. 820, Preface, trans. Frederic Rosen, 1831

thoughts.text: When a person is not doing his job, there can only be two reasons for it. The person either can’t do it or won’t do it; he is either not capable or not motivated.
thoughts.author: Andy Grove
thoughts.source: High Output Management

thoughts.text: The Struggle is where greatness comes from.
thoughts.author: Ben Horowitz
thoughts.source: The Struggle (a16z essay)

thoughts.text: The only thing that matters is getting to product/market fit.
thoughts.author: Marc Andreessen
thoughts.source: The Only Thing That Matters

thoughts.text: Starting a company is like throwing yourself off the cliff and assembling an airplane on the way down.
thoughts.author: Reid Hoffman
thoughts.source: Bloomberg interview, quoted in Fast Company

thoughts.text: I strongly dislike the idea of money that isn’t working, wherever it happens to be sitting.
thoughts.author: Timur Turlov
thoughts.source: «Я — покупатель денег»: 10 цитат Тимура Турлова про бизнес, успех и черный день, Digital Business
thoughts.original: Мне крайне не нравится идея любых неработающих денег — где бы они ни лежали.

thoughts.text: At YC, we were challenged to do things that don’t scale: to start with the perfect experience for one person, then work backwards and scale it to 100 people who love us.
thoughts.author: Brian Chesky
thoughts.source: Y Combinator founder quotes

thoughts.text: Better a good product than a mediocre one with big cashback. Cashback buys a customer’s loyalty by making them dependent.
thoughts.author: David Melikidze
thoughts.source: Большое интервью с генеральным директором Payme, Spot.uz
thoughts.original: Мы считаем, что лучше иметь хороший продукт, чем средний по качеству с большим кешбэком. Кешбэк покупает лояльность клиента, поставив его в зависимость.

thoughts.text: The first follower transforms a lone nut into a leader.
thoughts.author: Derek Sivers
thoughts.source: How to Start a Movement (TED talk)

thoughts.text: You can’t sell somebody on the solution until they’ve bought the problem.
thoughts.author: Des Traynor
thoughts.source: Be Wary of Solving a Small, Rare Problem (YC talk)

thoughts.text: First principles is a kind of physics way of looking at the world. And what that really means is that you boil things down to the most fundamental truths and then reason up from there.
thoughts.author: Elon Musk
thoughts.source: Foundation interview with Kevin Rose, 2012

thoughts.text: Given a choice between what a successful team has learned and the source code they have produced, I would take the learning every time.
thoughts.author: Eric Ries
thoughts.source: Validated learning about customers (Startup Lessons Learned)

thoughts.text: Accounting is a department. Marketing isn’t. Marketing is something everyone in your company is doing 24/7/365.
thoughts.author: Jason Fried and David Heinemeier Hansson
thoughts.source: Rework

thoughts.text: Greatness is not intelligence. Greatness comes from character. And character isn’t formed out of smart people, it’s formed out of people who suffered.
thoughts.author: Jensen Huang
thoughts.source: Talk at Stanford Institute for Economic Policy Research, 2024

thoughts.text: Nothing else you do will matter if you are not making something people want. You can be the best spokesperson, the best fundraiser, the best programmer, but if you aren’t building a product that satisfies a real need, you’ll never succeed.
thoughts.author: Jessica Livingston
thoughts.source: How Not to Fail (YC Female Founders Conference, 2016)

thoughts.text: The product is always in service of people, not the other way around.
thoughts.author: Julie Zhuo
thoughts.source: The Death of “Users” and “Product Design”

thoughts.text: Adequate performance gets a generous severance package.
thoughts.author: Patty McCord
thoughts.source: Netflix Culture: Freedom & Responsibility (the Netflix culture deck)

thoughts.text: Don’t be intimidated by what you don’t know. That can be your greatest strength and ensure that you do things differently from everyone else.
thoughts.author: Sara Blakely
thoughts.source: Interviews, collected by Inc.

thoughts.text: A common man renowned for his cleverness is greater than a king who has been raised up by good fortune. A youth who sells his handiwork is worthier than an old man selling his beard.
thoughts.author: Abai Kunanbaev
thoughts.source: The Book of Words, Word Thirty-Seven
thoughts.original: Бақпен асқан патшадан мимен асқан қара артық; сақалын сатқан кәріден еңбегін сатқан бала артық.

thoughts.text: If you won’t admit it, and go on resuscitating the corpse, you lose money and you lose time.
thoughts.author: Akmal Paiziev
thoughts.source: Spot.uz interview, “Цена провала: Акмаль Пайзиев про свои ошибки, проблемы со спецслужбами, закрытые проекты и сделанные выводы” (11 July 2019)
thoughts.original: И если ты не признаешь это, продолжая реанимировать труп — ты теряешь деньги и время.

thoughts.text: Whatever is sown today is worth the sowing, because tomorrow is its harvest day.
thoughts.author: Alisher Navoi
thoughts.source: Hayrat ul-Abror (Wonder of the Good), c. 1483
thoughts.original: Ne bukun ekilsa, bu maqbul erur, / Kim, anga tongla kuni mahsul erur.

thoughts.text: Haste is the head of every ill-begotten act, deliberation the companion of every deed well done.
thoughts.author: Yusuf Balasaguni
thoughts.source: Kutadgu Bilig (Wisdom of Royal Glory), trans. Robert Dankoff

thoughts.text: By planning, you can set your compass, but not the road itself.
thoughts.author: Zafar Khashimov
thoughts.source: Spot.uz interview, “Цена провала: Зафар Хашимов о том, как шесть лет закрывал City Taxi, почему не взлетел Five, своих ошибках и страхах” (11 August 2021)
thoughts.original: Планируя, вы можете настроить себе компас, но не сам путь.

thoughts.text: Those of the chemical craft know well that no change can be effected in the different species of substances, though they can produce the appearance of such change.
thoughts.author: Ibn Sina (Avicenna)
thoughts.source: Kitab al-Shifa (The Book of Healing), on the congealing of stones

thoughts.text: All happy companies are different: each one earns a monopoly by solving a unique problem. All failed companies are the same: they failed to escape competition.
thoughts.author: Peter Thiel
thoughts.source: Zero to One

thoughts.text: Day 2 is stasis. Followed by irrelevance. Followed by excruciating, painful decline. Followed by death.
thoughts.author: Jeff Bezos
thoughts.source: 2016 Letter to Shareholders

thoughts.text: The way to get startup ideas is not to try to think of startup ideas. It’s to look for problems, preferably problems you have yourself.
thoughts.author: Paul Graham
thoughts.source: How to Get Startup Ideas

thoughts.text: The most counterintuitive secret about startups is that it’s often easier to succeed with a hard startup than an easy one.
thoughts.author: Sam Altman
thoughts.source: Hard Startups

thoughts.text: You’ve got to start with the customer experience and work backwards to the technology.
thoughts.author: Steve Jobs
thoughts.source: WWDC 1997 closing Q&A

thoughts.text: The head of virtue is the tongue. Whoever commands good speech gains honour by it.
thoughts.author: Mahmud al-Kashgari
thoughts.source: Dīwān Lughāt al-Turk, 1072–74 — Turkic proverb recorded by al-Kashgari, with his own Arabic gloss
thoughts.original: Erdem başı til

thoughts.text: Sometimes I look at someone’s product and think: how is this even possible? Does the head of that company actually use this product himself?
thoughts.author: Mikheil Lomtadze
thoughts.source: «Михаил Ломтадзе впервые рассказал, как устроен Kaspi.kz», Tengrinews
thoughts.original: Я иногда смотрю чей-то продукт и думаю: ну как так можно? Руководитель компании сам этим продуктом реально пользуется?

thoughts.text: This book is not a polemical one. My book is nothing but a simple historic record of facts.
thoughts.author: Al-Biruni
thoughts.source: Alberuni’s India, c. 1030, Preface, trans. Edward C. Sachau

thoughts.text: But what if you don’t turn bitter, and use those circumstances as a source of strength instead?
thoughts.author: Arsen Tomsky
thoughts.source: Talk at the UMAI forum, Astana, reported by Digital Business
thoughts.original: Но что, если не становиться злым и использовать эти обстоятельства как источник силы?

thoughts.text: The road to the Bentley is not one, two, three years. But work stubbornly for ten, twenty, thirty years and you will certainly get there.
thoughts.author: Ramil Mukhoryapov
thoughts.source: Interview, «Chocofamily станет больше Google, Facebook и Amazon», Zhazhda
thoughts.original: Путь до «Бентли» – это не 1-2-3 года. Но если упорно работать 10-20-30 лет – обязательно всего добьешься.

thoughts.text: Soon is not as good as now.
thoughts.author: Seth Godin
thoughts.source: Poke the Box

thoughts.text: There are no facts inside the building, so get the hell outside.
thoughts.author: Steve Blank
thoughts.source: The Startup Owner’s Manual

thoughts.text: When a man’s judgments and advice have been tested many times and found sound, he is no longer asked for a proof of what he says.
thoughts.author: Al-Farabi
thoughts.source: Selected Aphorisms (Fusul al-Madani), aphorism 45

thoughts.text: ...a short work on Calculating by (the rules of) Completion and Reduction, confining it to what is easiest and most useful in arithmetic, such as men constantly require in cases of inheritance, legacies, partition, law-suits, and trade.
thoughts.author: Al-Khwarizmi
thoughts.source: The Algebra of Mohammed ben Musa, c. 820, Dedication, trans. Frederic Rosen, 1831 — verified verbatim; restored to Rosen's wording and marked as a mid-sentence fragment

thoughts.text: The output of a manager is the output of the organizational units under his or her supervision or influence.
thoughts.author: Andy Grove
thoughts.source: High Output Management

thoughts.text: Peacetime CEO works to minimize conflict. Wartime CEO heightens the contradictions.
thoughts.author: Ben Horowitz
thoughts.source: Peacetime CEO/Wartime CEO (a16z essay)

thoughts.text: In a great market, a market with lots of real potential customers, the market pulls product out of the startup.
thoughts.author: Marc Andreessen
thoughts.source: The Pmarca Guide to Startups, part 4: The only thing that matters

thoughts.text: I believe starting a company is like jumping off a cliff and assembling a plane on the way down. Your willingness to jump is your most valuable asset as an entrepreneur.
thoughts.author: Reid Hoffman
thoughts.source: Reid Hoffman, on X

thoughts.text: If you don’t want to take risks and step out of your comfort zone, better not to become an entrepreneur.
thoughts.author: Timur Turlov
thoughts.source: «Тимур Турлов и его принципы», Kompaniya (ko.ru)
thoughts.original: Если ты не хочешь рисковать и выходить из зоны комфорта, лучше не становиться предпринимателем.

thoughts.text: If you want your labors to be successful, start the job in hand wisely.
thoughts.author: Abai Kunanbaev
thoughts.source: The Book of Words, Word Thirty-Seven

thoughts.text: Copying well is an art too. Anyone who thinks I just skim the cream off other people’s ideas should try stealing something competently and building a product out of it.
thoughts.author: Akmal Paiziev
thoughts.source: Spot.uz interview, “Цена провала: Акмаль Пайзиев про свои ошибки, проблемы со спецслужбами, закрытые проекты и сделанные выводы” (11 July 2019)
thoughts.original: Хорошо скопировать — тоже искусство. Пусть все, кто считает, что я просто копирую и собираю сливки с чужих идей, попробует что-то грамотно «украсть» и построить продукт.

thoughts.text: If you are human, do not call that one human who takes no grief from the grief of the people.
thoughts.author: Alisher Navoi
thoughts.source: Hayrat ul-Abror (Wonder of the Good), c. 1483
thoughts.original: Odami ersang demagil odami, / Oniki yo‘q xalq g‘amidin g‘ami.

thoughts.text: Whatever you undertake, consider what the issue will be, for if you fail to reckon the expense, it will turn out to be a loss.
thoughts.author: Yusuf Balasaguni
thoughts.source: Kutadgu Bilig (Wisdom of Royal Glory), trans. Robert Dankoff

thoughts.text: The valuable idea is how to do it: what will put me ahead of the whole crowd trying to do the same thing, how to do it better and cheaper.
thoughts.author: Zafar Khashimov
thoughts.source: Spot.uz, Alter Ego interview: “Зафар Хашимов: об инвестициях, монополиях, НДС и ценах, будущем Узбекистана и многом другом” (15 April 2019)
thoughts.original: Ценная идея заключается в том, как это сделать, что сделает меня впереди всей толпы, которая пытается это сделать, как это сделать качественнее и дешевле.

thoughts.text: The knowledge of anything is not acquired or complete unless it is known by its causes.
thoughts.author: Ibn Sina (Avicenna)
thoughts.source: The Canon of Medicine, c. 1025

thoughts.text: The most contrarian thing of all is not to oppose the crowd but to think for yourself.
thoughts.author: Peter Thiel
thoughts.source: Zero to One

thoughts.text: Most decisions should probably be made with somewhere around 70% of the information you wish you had. If you wait for 90%, in most cases, you’re probably being slow.
thoughts.author: Jeff Bezos
thoughts.source: 2016 Letter to Shareholders

thoughts.text: Actually startups take off because the founders make them take off.
thoughts.author: Paul Graham
thoughts.source: Do Things That Don’t Scale

thoughts.text: The best case, by far, is to have a good cofounder. The next best is to be a solo founder. The worse case, by far, is to have a bad cofounder.
thoughts.author: Sam Altman
thoughts.source: Startup Playbook

thoughts.text: Focusing is about saying no. And the result of that focus is going to be some really great products where the total is much greater than the sum of the parts.
thoughts.author: Steve Jobs
thoughts.source: WWDC 1997 closing Q&A

thoughts.text: By the tongue you reach the table. It is said of the man who is told to make his worth known by speaking.
thoughts.author: Mahmud al-Kashgari
thoughts.source: Dīwān Lughāt al-Turk, 1072–74 — Turkic proverb recorded by al-Kashgari, with his own Arabic gloss
thoughts.original: Tilin tergige tegir

thoughts.text: The product has to be good from the start. We can’t afford to experiment on our customers.
thoughts.author: Mikheil Lomtadze
thoughts.source: Panel at Digital Bridge 2025, Astana, reported by Digital Business
thoughts.original: Продукт должен быть качественным сразу. Мы не можем позволить себе экспериментировать на клиентах.

thoughts.text: That man only is praiseworthy who shrinks from a lie and always adheres to the truth, enjoying credit even among liars.
thoughts.author: Al-Biruni
thoughts.source: Alberuni’s India, c. 1030, Preface, trans. Edward C. Sachau

thoughts.text: Many of us run into injustice. But what if you don't turn bitter, and use those circumstances as a source of strength instead?
thoughts.author: Arsen Tomsky
thoughts.source: Talk to UMAI women entrepreneurs in Astana, reported by Digital Business, 22 August 2025
thoughts.original: Многие из нас сталкиваются с несправедливостью. Но что, если не становиться злым и использовать эти обстоятельства как источник силы?

thoughts.text: A fortune is a reflection of the value you gave the world. It would be strange to set out to give less value than someone else does.
thoughts.author: Ramil Mukhoryapov
thoughts.source: Interview, «Chocofamily станет больше Google, Facebook и Amazon», Zhazhda
thoughts.original: Состояние – это отражение ценности, которую ты дал миру. Странно ведь стремиться дать ценность меньше, чем ее дает кто-то другой.

thoughts.text: In a crowded marketplace, fitting in is failing. In a busy marketplace, not standing out is the same as being invisible.
thoughts.author: Seth Godin
thoughts.source: Purple Cow

thoughts.text: Unless you have tested the assumptions in your business model first, outside the building, your business plan is just creative writing.
thoughts.author: Steve Blank
thoughts.source: No Plan Survives First Contact With Customers

thoughts.text: Success and good luck make a man drunk. Only one in a thousand can keep cool and reasonable.
thoughts.author: Abai Kunanbaev
thoughts.source: The Book of Words, Word Thirty-Seven

thoughts.text: First they look at you, then at the idea, then at the numbers. The weightiest factor is people: you, your team.
thoughts.author: Akmal Paiziev
thoughts.source: Spot.uz interview, “Цена провала: Акмаль Пайзиев про свои ошибки, проблемы со спецслужбами, закрытые проекты и сделанные выводы” (11 July 2019)
thoughts.original: Сначала смотрят на тебя, потом на идею, потом на цифры. Самый весомый фактор — люди, ты, твоя команда.

thoughts.text: Generosity is the noblest of qualities. Push it past measure and it is only waste.
thoughts.author: Alisher Navoi
thoughts.source: Hayrat ul-Abror (Wonder of the Good), c. 1483
thoughts.original: Necha saxo ashrafi avsofdur, / Mufrit agar aylasang isrofdur.

thoughts.text: Consultation is the medicine prescribed for every action proposed. Consult with a near one and your undertaking will prosper, fail to consult and you will rue the day.
thoughts.author: Yusuf Balasaguni
thoughts.source: Kutadgu Bilig (Wisdom of Royal Glory), trans. Robert Dankoff

thoughts.text: A locomotive cannot arrive at point B leaving the last car at point A.
thoughts.author: Zafar Khashimov
thoughts.source: Spot.uz interview, “Цена провала: Зафар Хашимов о том, как шесть лет закрывал City Taxi, почему не взлетел Five, своих ошибках и страхах” (11 August 2021)
thoughts.original: Паровоз не может прийти в точку Б, оставив последний вагон в точке А.

thoughts.text: As to the claims of the alchemists, it must be clearly understood that it is not in their power to bring about any true change of species. They can, however, produce excellent imitations.
thoughts.author: Ibn Sina (Avicenna)
thoughts.source: Kitab al-Shifa, sections on minerals, trans. Holmyard & Mandeville, Avicennae de Congelatione et Conglutinatione Lapidum (Paris, 1927), p. 41. REPLACED the candidate's wording, which was a loose English rendering of the medieval Latin 'Sciant artifices alchemiae' paraphrase circulated via Wikipedia, not a translation of Ibn Sina's Arabic.

thoughts.text: What important truth do very few people agree with you on?
thoughts.author: Peter Thiel
thoughts.source: Zero to One

thoughts.text: Will this person raise the average level of effectiveness of the group they’re entering? We want to fight entropy. The bar has to continuously go up.
thoughts.author: Jeff Bezos
thoughts.source: 1998 Amazon shareholder letter

thoughts.text: You can’t wait for users to come to you. You have to go out and get them.
thoughts.author: Paul Graham
thoughts.source: Do Things That Don’t Scale

thoughts.text: Resist the urge to derive your self-worth from your number of employees.
thoughts.author: Sam Altman
thoughts.source: Startup Playbook

thoughts.text: A small team of A+ players can run circles around a giant team of B and C players.
thoughts.author: Steve Jobs
thoughts.source: Smithsonian/Computerworld oral history interview, 1995

thoughts.text: Whoever spits at the sky gets it back on his own face.
thoughts.author: Mahmud al-Kashgari
thoughts.source: Dīwān Lughāt al-Turk, 1072–74 — Turkic proverb recorded by al-Kashgari
thoughts.original: Kökke sagursa, yüzke tüşer

thoughts.text: The product has to be high-quality from the start. We can't afford to experiment on our customers.
thoughts.author: Mikheil Lomtadze
thoughts.source: Panel session at Digital Bridge 2025, Astana, 3 October 2025; transcript published by Digital Business
thoughts.original: Продукт должен быть качественным сразу. Мы не можем позволить себе экспериментировать на клиентах.

thoughts.text: While you are seeking happiness, everybody wishes you well; but once you have attained it, your only well-wisher is yourself.
thoughts.author: Abai Kunanbaev
thoughts.source: The Book of Words, Word Thirty-Seven

thoughts.text: I try to see the mistake as early as possible, and if it can’t be corrected I close the project. That way it costs me less.
thoughts.author: Akmal Paiziev
thoughts.source: Spot.uz interview, “Цена провала: Акмаль Пайзиев про свои ошибки, проблемы со спецслужбами, закрытые проекты и сделанные выводы” (11 July 2019)
thoughts.original: Я стараюсь как можно раньше увидеть ошибку, и если ее невозможно исправить — закрываю проекты. Так она обходится мне дешевле.

thoughts.text: He spreads a table for the one who is not hungry, and gives a coat to the one who is not bare.
thoughts.author: Alisher Navoi
thoughts.source: Hayrat ul-Abror (Wonder of the Good), c. 1483
thoughts.original: Yoyar anga supraki, ul och emas, / Berur anga to‘nki, yalang‘och emas.

thoughts.text: Whatever you wish to undertake, first consult your own heart, only then other people; and if your heart is not pleased with it, then stay away from it.
thoughts.author: Yusuf Balasaguni
thoughts.source: Kutadgu Bilig (Wisdom of Royal Glory), trans. Robert Dankoff

thoughts.text: The labour by which we earn our bread is very, very fine-grained and painstaking.
thoughts.author: Zafar Khashimov
thoughts.source: Spot.uz, Alter Ego interview: “Зафар Хашимов: об инвестициях, монополиях, НДС и ценах, будущем Узбекистана и многом другом” (15 April 2019)
thoughts.original: Труд, которым мы добываем свой хлеб, очень-очень мелкий и скрупулезный.

thoughts.text: It is a dictum of the exact sciences that knowledge of a thing is attained only through a knowledge of the causes and the origins of the causes.
thoughts.author: Ibn Sina (Avicenna)
thoughts.source: The Canon of Medicine, c. 1025, Book I, Part 1, Thesis 2 (section 12), trans. O. Cameron Gruner. REPLACED the candidate's Wikiquote wording, which matches no verifiable translation.

thoughts.text: Most businesses get zero distribution channels to work: poor sales rather than bad product is the most common cause of failure.
thoughts.author: Peter Thiel
thoughts.source: Zero to One

thoughts.text: A remarkable customer experience starts with heart, intuition, curiosity, play, guts, taste. You won’t find any of it in a survey.
thoughts.author: Jeff Bezos
thoughts.source: 2016 Letter to Amazon Shareholders

thoughts.text: There are things founders can do that managers can’t, and not doing them feels wrong to founders, because it is.
thoughts.author: Paul Graham
thoughts.source: Founder Mode

thoughts.text: It’s much better to first make a product a small number of users love than a product that a large number of users like.
thoughts.author: Sam Altman
thoughts.source: Startup Playbook

thoughts.text: It’s really hard to design products by focus groups. A lot of times, people don’t know what they want until you show it to them.
thoughts.author: Steve Jobs
thoughts.source: BusinessWeek interview, 25 May 1998

thoughts.text: To the lazy man, even a cloud is a burden.
thoughts.author: Mahmud al-Kashgari
thoughts.source: Divanu Lugat al-Turk, 1072-74 — an anonymous Turkic proverb al-Kashgari recorded, not his own words. Verified in Mirzezade, Akademik Tarih ve Dusunce Dergisi 12:6 (2025). The candidate's 'shadow of a cloud' is that article author's interpretive addition; Atalay's standard reading is simply 'a cloud'.
thoughts.original: Ermegüge bulit yük bolur

thoughts.text: Judge a man’s qualities by the intentions of his action and not by its outcome.
thoughts.author: Abai Kunanbaev
thoughts.source: The Book of Words, Word Thirty-Seven

thoughts.text: Imagine you’re fifty, and you think: I could have done more. You won’t know unless you try.
thoughts.author: Akmal Paiziev
thoughts.source: Spot.uz interview, “Цена провала: Акмаль Пайзиев про свои ошибки, проблемы со спецслужбами, закрытые проекты и сделанные выводы” (11 July 2019)
thoughts.original: А представь, тебе 50, и ты такой: «Я же мог сделать больше…» Не попробуешь — не узнаешь.

thoughts.text: A log set burning alone yields nothing but smoke.
thoughts.author: Alisher Navoi
thoughts.source: Hayrat ul-Abror (Wonder of the Good), c. 1483
thoughts.original: Yorsiz el ohi g‘amandud erur, / Yonsa yig‘och yolg‘uz, ishi dud erur.

thoughts.text: Words left unspoken are purest gold, but as soon as they emerge on the tongue, they turn to copper.
thoughts.author: Yusuf Balasaguni
thoughts.source: Kutadgu Bilig (Wisdom of Royal Glory), couplet 1916, trans. Robert Dankoff
thoughts.original: Sözüg sözlemese sav altun sanı, bakır boldı tildin çıkarsa anı.

thoughts.text: Business is an absorbing game, a journey, not a war. Too many people treat it as war and use military words: seize the market, take it away.
thoughts.author: Zafar Khashimov
thoughts.source: Spot.uz interview, “Цена провала: Зафар Хашимов о том, как шесть лет закрывал City Taxi, почему не взлетел Five, своих ошибках и страхах” (11 August 2021)
thoughts.original: Бизнес — это увлекательная игра, путешествие, не война. Многие воспринимают бизнес как войну, слишком много используют военных терминов: захватить, отнять рынок и так далее.

thoughts.text: I read the Metaphysics, but did not understand its contents and was baffled by the author's intention; I read it over forty times, until I had the text by heart. Even then I did not understand it or what the author meant.
thoughts.author: Ibn Sina (Avicenna)
thoughts.source: Autobiography, in Avicenna on Theology, trans. A. J. Arberry (1951), p. 12. Candidate compressed roughly 120 words into two sentences with invented connective wording; restored to Arberry's text (recovered from a noisy scan).

thoughts.text: Like acting, sales works best when hidden.
thoughts.author: Peter Thiel
thoughts.source: Zero to One

thoughts.text: Customers are always beautifully, wonderfully dissatisfied, even when they report being happy and business is great.
thoughts.author: Jeff Bezos
thoughts.source: 2016 Letter to Amazon Shareholders

thoughts.text: It’s not the product that should be insanely great, but the experience of being your user.
thoughts.author: Paul Graham
thoughts.source: Do Things that Don’t Scale

thoughts.text: Would your users be truly bummed if your company went away?
thoughts.author: Sam Altman
thoughts.source: Startup Playbook

thoughts.text: Focusing is about saying no. And you've got to say no, no, no. ... The result of that focus is going to be some really great products where the total is much greater than the sum of the parts.
thoughts.author: Steve Jobs
thoughts.source: WWDC 1997 closing Q&A

thoughts.text: Even the hardest earth will yield good crops to honest and selfless toil.
thoughts.author: Abai Kunanbaev
thoughts.source: The Book of Words, Word Four

thoughts.text: In any conditions, even the most inconvenient ones, you can work out a business model that will take off.
thoughts.author: Akmal Paiziev
thoughts.source: Spot.uz interview, “Цена провала: Акмаль Пайзиев про свои ошибки, проблемы со спецслужбами, закрытые проекты и сделанные выводы” (11 July 2019)
thoughts.original: Считаю, что в любых условиях, даже самых «неудобных», можно разработать бизнес-модель, которая выстрелит.

thoughts.text: Do not mistake treasure and display for wealth. The treasure of wealth is having enough.
thoughts.author: Alisher Navoi
thoughts.source: Hayrat ul-Abror (Wonder of the Good), c. 1483
thoughts.original: Ganj-u tajammulni g‘ino bilmagil, / Balki g‘ino ganji qanoatni bil.

thoughts.text: As long as the wise man does not bring out wisdom upon his tongue, his wisdom may lie hidden for years and shed no light.
thoughts.author: Yusuf Balasaguni
thoughts.source: Kutadgu Bilig (Wisdom of Royal Glory), trans. Robert Dankoff

thoughts.text: That was when I understood that a person doesn’t do business in order to get rich.
thoughts.author: Zafar Khashimov
thoughts.source: Spot.uz interview, “Цена провала: Зафар Хашимов о том, как шесть лет закрывал City Taxi, почему не взлетел Five, своих ошибках и страхах” (11 August 2021)
thoughts.original: Я тогда понял, что человек делает бизнес не чтобы разбогатеть.

thoughts.text: I prepared a set of files; with each proof I examined, I set down the syllogistic premisses and put them in order in the files, then I examined what deductions might be drawn from them.
thoughts.author: Ibn Sina (Avicenna)
thoughts.source: Autobiography, in Avicenna on Theology, trans. A. J. Arberry (1951) — restored to Arberry's wording; candidate dropped 'syllogistic' and changed 'the files' to 'a file'

thoughts.text: If you’ve invented something new but you haven’t invented an effective way to sell it, you have a bad business, no matter how good the product.
thoughts.author: Peter Thiel
thoughts.source: Zero to One

thoughts.text: I have yet to see a person who, having acquired wealth by dishonest means, has put it to good use. Ill-gotten gains are likewise ill spent.
thoughts.author: Abai Kunanbaev
thoughts.source: The Book of Words, Word Ten

thoughts.text: Three things to beware of in business: loss of reputation, unjustified risks, and too many promises.
thoughts.author: Akmal Paiziev
thoughts.source: Kapital.uz, “Правила бизнеса” series (18 December 2020)
thoughts.original: Три главных аспекта, которых нужно остерегаться в бизнесе: потеря репутации, неоправданные риски и чрезмерное количество обещаний.

thoughts.text: Generosity is the noblest of qualities; but push it to excess and it is only waste.
thoughts.author: Alisher Navoi
thoughts.source: Hayrat ul-Abror, c. 1483 — verified in Alisher Navoiy, Hayrat ul-abror, 9-jild (Tashkent: G'afur G'ulom, 2018)
thoughts.original: Necha saxo ashrafi avsofdur, / Mufrit agar aylasang isrofdur.

thoughts.text: Whenever much labor is invested in a thing it becomes loved and desired.
thoughts.author: Yusuf Balasaguni
thoughts.source: Kutadgu Bilig (Wisdom of Royal Glory), trans. Robert Dankoff

thoughts.text: The most important thing in business is not knowing good answers, but asking the right questions.
thoughts.author: Zafar Khashimov
thoughts.source: Depozit.uz, “Korzinka.uz asoschisi – Zafar Xoshimovdan biznesga oid iqtiboslar” (compilation of his business rules)
thoughts.original: Biznesda eng muhimi — yaxshi javoblarni bilish emas, balki to‘g‘ri savollar berishdir.

thoughts.text: If you do not value your own knowledge, how can you expect recognition from utter strangers?
thoughts.author: Abai Kunanbaev
thoughts.source: The Book of Words, Word Thirty-Two

thoughts.text: Working at a company is first of all about gaining experience. Who would I learn from at my own company?
thoughts.author: Akmal Paiziev
thoughts.source: Kapital.uz, “Правила бизнеса” series (18 December 2020)
thoughts.original: Работа в какой-либо компании – это в первую очередь получение опыта. У кого я буду учиться в своей компании?

thoughts.text: Do not take treasure and display for wealth; know rather that contentment is the treasure of wealth.
thoughts.author: Alisher Navoi
thoughts.source: Hayrat ul-Abror, c. 1483 — verified in Alisher Navoiy, Hayrat ul-abror, 9-jild (Tashkent: G'afur G'ulom, 2018); from the chapter on qanoat (contentment)
thoughts.original: Ganj-u tajammulni g'ino bilmagil, / Balki g'ino ganji qanoatni bil.

thoughts.text: For me work and pleasure walk side by side; the more I work, the happier I am!
thoughts.author: Yusuf Balasaguni
thoughts.source: Kutadgu Bilig (Wisdom of Royal Glory), trans. Robert Dankoff

thoughts.text: I always do my shopping at korzinka.uz. You must taste your own business.
thoughts.author: Zafar Khashimov
thoughts.source: Depozit.uz, “Korzinka.uz asoschisi – Zafar Xoshimovdan biznesga oid iqtiboslar” (compilation of his business rules)
thoughts.original: Men doim xaridlarni korzinka.uz dan amalga oshiraman. Siz, albatta, o‘z biznesingizni mazasini tatib ko‘rishingiz kerak.

thoughts.text: If you have succeeded in your pursuit of a truth, do not turn back from it even on pain of death.
thoughts.author: Abai Kunanbaev
thoughts.source: The Book of Words, Word Thirty-Two

thoughts.text: The sigh of the friendless is clouded with grief; when wood burns alone, all its work is smoke.
thoughts.author: Alisher Navoi
thoughts.source: Hayrat ul-Abror, c. 1483 — verified in Alisher Navoiy, Hayrat ul-abror, 9-jild (Tashkent: G'afur G'ulom, 2018). Candidate translated only the second hemistich; both are given here so original and English match.
thoughts.original: Yorsiz el ohi g'amandud erur, / Yonsa yig'och yolg'uz, ishi dud erur.

thoughts.text: Seek not life alone, but also a good name; for you will die soon, but your name will remain behind.
thoughts.author: Yusuf Balasaguni
thoughts.source: Kutadgu Bilig (Wisdom of Royal Glory), trans. Robert Dankoff

thoughts.text: Even a craftsman’s skill improves from day to day if he works with enthusiasm.
thoughts.author: Abai Kunanbaev
thoughts.source: The Book of Words, Word Forty-Three

thoughts.text: And if you don't admit it, and go on resuscitating the corpse, you lose money and time.
thoughts.author: Akmal Paiziev
thoughts.source: Spot.uz interview, “Цена провала: Акмаль Пайзиев про свои ошибки, проблемы со спецслужбами, закрытые проекты и сделанные выводы” (11 July 2019)
thoughts.original: И если ты не признаешь это, продолжая реанимировать труп — ты теряешь деньги и время.

thoughts.text: In speech there is nothing so unworthy as a lie.
thoughts.author: Alisher Navoi
thoughts.source: Hayrat ul-Abror, c. 1483 — verified in Alisher Navoiy, Hayrat ul-abror, 9-jild (Tashkent: G'afur G'ulom, 2018). 'nopisand' is closer to 'unworthy/unacceptable' than the candidate's 'contemptible'.
thoughts.original: So'z aro yolg'on kibi yo'q nopisand

thoughts.text: One who begins his enterprise with knowledge will gain his desire in the end, no matter what it may be.
thoughts.author: Yusuf Balasaguni
thoughts.source: Kutadgu Bilig (Wisdom of Royal Glory), trans. Robert Dankoff
